sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety in one unified table. It ranked AREX first, OpenForgeRL second, Dark Room third, and flagged GuardianAgentBench, Self-Explanation Faithfulness, Rewarding Better Thinking, PRO-LONG, OpenSkillRisk, RESOURCE2SKILL, and RHI as high or recent duplicate risks.
Read arXiv PDF, HTML, TeX source, and Hugging Face model card; extracted formulas, tables, ablations, and evidence boundaries.
Explained AREX inner research loop, outer self-improvement loop, autonomous context updating, key-step supervision, and step-aware RL.
Flagged limits around private training data, confidence calibration, open-web pollution, benchmark comparability, and reproducibility.
Located official AREX-Turbo model card and used paper related-work framing to position verification and memory mechanisms.
Wrote pure Markdown with TL;DR, claim-mechanism-evidence-boundary table, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, and localized figures.
